old_caption: A close-up view shows a stream of red ketchup being poured onto a pile of golden-brown potato wedges on a white plate. The ketchup flows in a continuous stream, coating the wedges and pooling slightly on the plate. The pouring action is steady and uninterrupted. The camera remains fixed, keeping the focus on the plate and the ketchup as it is applied. The background is dark, which makes the colors of the food stand out. No other objects or characters are visible in the scene.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a plate filled with golden-brown, crispy potato wedges. The wedges are arranged in a casual pile on a plain white plate, which is set against a dark background, emphasizing the vibrant color of the potatoes. As the video progresses, a stream of bright red ketchup is poured onto the wedges from above. The ketchup flows smoothly, creating a vivid contrast against the yellow of the potatoes. The pouring action continues, with the ketchup cascading down and pooling slightly on the wedges, adding a glossy sheen to the surface. The focus remains tightly on the plate throughout, highlighting the texture and color of both the potatoes and the ketchup. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady position, ensuring that the viewer's attention is solely on the plate and the pouring ketchup.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a white plate piled with thick-cut golden fries against a dark background, with a vertical stream of orange-red ketchup falling from above the frame. At the start the pour is already underway, a thick continuous column landing on a rounded ketchup blob on a lower-left fry. As the clip progresses the stream narrows and its contact point travels rightward and upward, laying a red streak along the top edge of an upright central fry. The flow then thins into a fine thread that intermittently breaks into a pointed jet or a falling droplet, sometimes absent in a frame while the sauce remains. A small additional ketchup dot appears on the uppermost horizontal fry as the thread continues to fall. The fries, plate, and background hold identical positions throughout, indicating a static camera, while only the stream and accumulated sauce change. The pour is still in motion at the last frame, with no source of the ketchup ever shown.
